summary: This note covers the growing emphasis on mental fitness in local youth competitive athletics, drawing on a sports psychologist, a coach and several young athletes. It addresses resilience, stress and anxiety, emotion management, peer and parental pressure, school-sport balance, self-esteem and social media. It closes by noting upcoming mental skills training workshops that integrate psychological and physical training.
one_line: Local youth sports programs are prioritizing mental fitness, from resilience and anxiety to social media pressures, with workshops planned for athletes.
key_facts: On September 5, 2023, local youth athletic programs across the city were placing renewed emphasis on mental well-being as the autumn sports season began.
Dr. Samantha Ellis, a sports psychologist, said: "Physical prowess is only part of the equation."
Mike Johnson, a veteran youth soccer coach, said that when kids learn to bounce back from setbacks, "they become not just better players, but stronger individuals."
Sara Nguyen, a 14-year-old tennis prodigy, is learning techniques to calm herself and stay focused before matches.
Young athletes are taught breathing exercises and visualization to keep pre-game jitters at bay.
Jordan Blake, a 16-year-old basketball player, learned after losing a crucial game not to let anger and disappointment control him.
On October 12, 2023, a panel discussion on youth sports psychology was held at the local community center.
At the panel, Dr. Ellis warned of the fine line between encouragement and undue pressure that can lead to burnout or resistance.
Lisa Monroe, a 15-year-old swimmer, says she cannot let swimming take over her life because grades, friends and downtime matter too.
Emily Turner, a 12-year-old local gymnast, says her coaches cheer new moves and that it is about beating her own personal best rather than winning.
Youth sports circles are increasingly adopting initiatives teaching digital literacy and the psychological effects of social media.
As of November 29, 2023, workshops on mental skills training for youth athletes were scheduled.
